description: Frozen before recipe/cutoff selection. Generated content, no personal files. Text segments exercise retrieval only; generated media must use actual worker inputs and code must separately pass parser/opt-in integration.

segments.text: The community library lends books for three weeks. Return borrowed items through the slot beside the front door after closing. Overdue notices arrive by email.
To reset the garden irrigation controller, hold the blue button for ten seconds. The watering schedule is restored from the backup battery after a power failure.
Warranty coverage for the rechargeable drill lasts twenty-four months. Damage caused by immersion in water is excluded. Keep the purchase receipt when requesting a replacement.
NETWORK UNAVAILABLE. The wireless adapter cannot connect to the office access point. Restart the router and check the connection settings. Diagnostic code NET-5842.
RIVER STREET BAKERY. Sourdough loaf 4.50. Two croissants 5.00. Total 9.50. Paid by card.

/// Remove the least recently used cache entry when capacity is exhausted.
pub fn evict_oldest(cache: &mut Cache) { cache.remove_lru(); }

media_generation.speech: The museum opens at nine in the morning. Tickets for the dinosaur exhibition can be purchased at the entrance. Children under six visit free of charge.
